```{r Transform Shape Files}
# Transform these shape files

Islands <- Islands_shape_data %>% mutate(layer = "Islands")
Islands <- st_transform(Islands, 4326)

Mangroves <- Mangroves_shape_data %>% mutate(layer = "Mangroves")
Mangroves <- st_transform(Mangroves, 4326)

RockySargassum <- RockySargassum_shape_data %>% mutate(layer = "Rocky Sargassum")
RockySargassum <- st_transform(RockySargassum, 4326)

Rodoliths <- Rodoliths_shape_data %>% mutate(layer = "Rodoliths")
Rodoliths <- st_transform(Rodoliths, 4326)

Rookeries <- Rookeries_shape_data %>% mutate(layer = "Rookeries")
Rookeries <- st_transform(Rookeries, 4326)

# Seagrass <- Seagrass_shape_data %>% mutate(layer = "Seagrass")
# Seagrass <- st_transform(Seagrass, 4326)

Seamount <- Seamount_shape_data %>% mutate(layer = "Seamount")
Seamount <- st_transform(Seamount, 4326)

Wetlands <- Wetlands_shape_data %>% mutate(layer = "Wetlands")
Wetlands <- st_transform(Wetlands, 4326)
```

```{r Plotting Habitat Layers}
bbox <- st_bbox(Islands)
x_limits <- c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"])
y_limits <- c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])


Islands_plot<- ggplot(Islands) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = layer), color = "chocolate4") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = "sandybrown") +
  coord_sf(xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Islands Layer",
    subtitle = "Reprojected to WGS84 (EPSG:4326)",
    fill = "Layer"
  ) + labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)

Mangroves_plot<- ggplot(Mangroves) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = layer), color = "darkgreen") +
```

```{r Join Habitat Layers in one Plot}
All_habitat_layers <- bind_rows(
  Islands,
  Mangroves,
  RockySargassum,
  Rodoliths,
  Rookeries,
  Seamount,
  Wetlands
  # Add Seagrass if/when ready
)


ggplot(All_habitat_layers) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = layer), color = "gray20", alpha = 0.6) +
  coord_sf(xlim = x_limits, ylim = y_limits, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Habitat Layer") +
  labs(
    title = "Combined Habitat Layers",
    subtitle = "All reprojected to WGS84 (EPSG:4326)"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Islands" = "chocolate",
      "Mangroves" = "darkgreen",
      "Rocky Sargassum" = "palegreen",
      "Rodoliths" = "tomato2",
      "Rookeries" = "lightblue",
      "Seamount" = "darkblue",
      "Wetlands" = "plum1"
    ))
```

```{r Interactive Map}
# Simplify these layers for speed:
Islands_clean <- Islands %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")
Islands_simpl <- st_simplify(Islands_clean, dTolerance = 0.001, preserveTopology = TRUE)

Mangroves_clean <- Mangroves %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")
Mangroves_simpl <- st_simplify(Mangroves_clean, dTolerance = 0.001, preserveTopology = TRUE)

RockySargassum_clean <- RockySargassum %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")
RockySargassum_simpl <- st_simplify(RockySargassum_clean, dTolerance = 0.001, preserveTopology = TRUE)

Rodoliths_clean <- Rodoliths %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")
Rodoliths_simpl <- st_simplify(Rodoliths_clean, dTolerance = 0.001, preserveTopology = TRUE)

Rookeries_clean <- Rookeries %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")
Rookeries_simpl <- st_simplify(Rookeries_clean, dTolerance = 0.001, preserveTopology = TRUE)

Seamount_clean <- Seamount %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")
Seamount_simpl <- st_simplify(Seamount_clean, dTolerance = 0.001, preserveTopology = TRUE)

# Wetlands data are a bit odd...
# 1. Fix invalid geometry
Wetlands_valid <- st_make_valid(Wetlands)

# 2. Explode any GEOMETRYCOLLECTIONs into parts
Wetlands_parts <- st_cast(Wetlands_valid, "GEOMETRY", warn = FALSE)

# 3. Keep only polygonal features
Wetlands_polys <- Wetlands_parts %>%
  filter(st_geometry_type(.) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON"))

# 4. Cast all to MULTIPOLYGON for consistency
Wetlands_clean <- st_cast(Wetlands_polys, "MULTIPOLYGON", warn = FALSE)

# 5. Simplify (optional for performance)
Wetlands_simpl <- st_simplify(Wetlands_clean, dTolerance = 0.001, preserveTopology = TRUE)


Habitat_interactive_map<- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%  # Light basemap

  # Add each layer with its own group
  addPolygons(data = Islands_simpl, group = "Islands", color = "chocolate", fillOpacity = 0.5, label = ~layer) %>%
  addPolygons(data = Mangroves_simpl, group = "Mangroves", color = "darkgreen", fillOpacity = 0.5, label = ~layer) %>%
  addPolygons(data = RockySargassum_simpl, group = "Rocky Sargassum", color = "orange", fillOpacity = 0.5, label = ~layer) %>%
  addPolygons(data = Rodoliths_simpl, group = "Rodoliths", color = "pink2", fillOpacity = 0.5, label = ~layer) %>%
  addPolygons(data = Rookeries_simpl, group = "Rookeries", color = "lightblue2", fillOpacity = 0.5, label = ~layer) %>%
  addPolygons(data = Seamount_simpl, group = "Seamount", color = "darkblue", fillOpacity = 0.5, label = ~layer) %>%
  addPolygons(data = Wetlands_simpl, group = "Wetlands", color = "orchid2", fillOpacity = 0.5, label = ~layer) %>%

  # Add a layer control panel (checkboxes)
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c(
      "Islands", "Mangroves", "Rocky Sargassum", "Rodoliths",
      "Rookeries", "Seamount", "Wetlands"
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```

